story.zh: 颜良文丑在白马之战中双双负伤。而官渡之战后，袁绍身死，袁氏内乱，双雄陷入了纠结之中。
story.en: Yan Liang and Wen Chou were both wounded in the Battle of Baima. Following the Battle of Guandu, Yuan Shao died and internal strife erupted within the Yuan clan, leaving the two heroes deeply conflicted.

participate.zh: 【与颜良文丑的关系等级均达到2级】，【主角信奉霸者道】，【官渡之战剧情已结束】，【颜良文丑在白马之战中双双存活】，【袁绍已死亡】。
participate.en: 【Relationship level with both Yan Liang and Wen Chou reaches Level 2】, 【Protagonist follows the Way of Might】, 【The Battle of Guandu plot has concluded】, 【Both Yan Liang and Wen Chou survived the Battle of Baima】, 【Yuan Shao is dead】.
